newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI Australia buys plastics business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI Australia buys plastics business.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Tuesday it had acquired the assets and goodwill of Mains Pty Ltd, a plastics compounding and processing business, which has annual sales of A$10 million.

"The acquisition will enhance ICI's position in servicing the key automotive, wire and cable and appliance markets, as well as providing a basis for further growth into southeast Asian markets," engineering plastics manager Stephen Bell said.
ICI Australia is 62.5 percent owned by Imperial Chemical Industries Plc.
